userStories.title: Sign in with email and password
userStories.goal: sign in with my email and password
acceptanceCriteria: [@ui] The sign-in page shows the heading 'Welcome back'.
[@ui] The page has an Email field, a Password field and a Sign in button.
[@functional] The Sign in button is disabled until both fields are filled.
[@functional] Signing in as buyer@example.test with Buyer#Pass2026 opens the page /orders.
[@error-handling] Submitting the password wrong-pass shows the error 'Email or password is incorrect'.
businessRules: The password must be between 8 and 64 characters.

ambiguities.question: After how many failed sign-in attempts is the account locked, and for how long?
